description: 收敛附件、图片、相册、远程导入、PDF 和上传资源业务，保持文件安全、持久化一致性与内容输出契约。

notes: 2026-09-15 specification audit completed; 2026-09-16 implementation/review added content roots, no-clobber store, bounded media, durable standalone-delete manifest primitives and the shared PDF renderer/runtime seam in 158a6dee. The 2026-09-17 specification re-audit aligned the in_progress baseline and D-C2 safety profile; explicit approval resumed implementation without repeating task.py start. The current uncommitted batch migrates Web image/upload/album/attachment access, remote/archive/PDF, notes provider paths, and ApiNote stable multipart assets to content/service boundaries with durable create/delete recovery. ApiNote uses PreNote generation 0 manifests: a committed parent note exact-verifies then finalizes, while a missing parent uses the ordinary delete/quarantine lifecycle then discards. Startup maintenance scans api_note_asset_upload pre-notes with an independent bounded budget, and generic recovery excludes them. interface-http still owns the sole production-config root binding. Real Mongo compensation/restart/GC, legacy no-OperationId cross-process safety, Go 1.26/real HTTP/browser/Linux runtime/cross-host evidence remain open.
